# Tabs

> Switch between peer panels of one object, with no JS: hidden radios drive the panels.

- Type: Component (disclosure, Navigation)
- Namespace: `ui.tabs`
- Source: `src/ui/tabs.cljc`
- Public fns: `tabs-class-list`, `tabs-classes`, `tabs`
- Keywords: tabs, tab panel, segmented, underline tabs, css only

## When to use

- Peer panels of one object: Overview, Activity, Settings.
- Content that should switch in place without a route change, on all targets including server-rendered hiccup.

## When not to use

- Use button-group for two to five views of the same data (a range or a layout toggle).
- Use accordion for stacked sections that are read in order.
- Use real links when each panel is its own page.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.tabs :as tabs])

(tabs/tabs {:variant :line
            :default "account"
            :tabs [{:id "account"  :label "Account"  :content [:div "..."]}
                   {:id "password" :label "Password" :content [:div "..."]}]})
```

## Examples

### Boxed segmented tabs with a fixed radio name

```clojure
(tabs/tabs {:name "view"
            :tabs [{:id "grid" :label "Grid" :content grid}
                   {:id "list" :label "List" :content list}]})
```

## API reference

### `tabs`

Renders a radio group of triggers and the matching panels. The active tab is uncontrolled; the browser tracks it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:variant` | `:boxed \| :line` | `:boxed` | :boxed is a segmented control with a raised pill; :line is underlined tabs. |
| `:default` | `string \| keyword` | – | Id of the initially active tab; defaults to the first. |
| `:tabs` | `vector of {:id :label :content}` | – | The tabs. :content is hiccup. |
| `:name` | `string` | – | Radio group name. Auto-generated when omitted; pass one for deterministic markup (tests, SSR snapshots). |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – | Attributes on the root element. |

### `tabs-classes`

Class string for {:variant}.

### `tabs-class-list`

Vector form.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Arrow keys | Move between tabs (native radio behavior). |
| Tab | Moves focus into and out of the tab list. |

## Accessibility

- Triggers are labels for radio inputs; the focus ring is drawn on the label of the focused radio.
- Panels are hidden with CSS :has(), so hidden content is not read.

## Motion

- Trigger color and background change over --duration-fast; no sliding indicator.

## Responsive behavior

- The tab list wraps; keep labels short. For many tabs prefer a select on phones.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Works without JS. State is not observable server-side.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Uncontrolled: to react to the active tab, listen for change on the radios via :attrs or render your own triggers.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant; pass :name to keep ids stable across re-renders.

## Notes for AI

- Tabs need no state; do not add an active-tab atom unless you must react to changes.
- For a range toggle (7d, 30d, 90d) use button-group, not tabs.

## Related

- `button-group`: Button group — a cluster of related buttons rendered as a segmented
- [Accordion](accordion.md): Progressively reveal supporting content in place, using native details and summary with no JS.
- `toolbar`: Toolbar — a rounded container that groups buttons (typically icon buttons)

## Guidance for AI tools

Tabs: Switch between peer panels of one object, with no JS: hidden radios drive the panels. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt


---

# Toast

> A brief floating confirmation for completed background work, shown by the JS runtime on every target.

- Type: Component (feedback, Messages)
- Namespace: `ui.toast`
- Source: `src/ui/toast.cljc`
- Public fns: `toast-class-list`, `toast-classes`, `toast`, `toast-flash`
- JS runtime: `ui.js.toast` (bundled in ui-runtime.js)
- Keywords: toast, notification, snackbar, flash message, htmx

## When to use

- Result of background work: an export finished, a sync failed, a message was sent.
- Server-rendered and HTMX responses that need a confirmation after a swap (toast-flash).

## When not to use

- Confirm foreground actions in place (the button label, the row, the value); never as the only confirmation.
- Use alert for a message that must stay until resolved.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.toast :as toast])

;; Replicant / Squint
(toast/show-toast! {:message "Export finished" :variant :success})

;; Hiccup / HTMX: include the marker in the response fragment
(toast/toast-flash {:message "Saved" :variant :success})
```

## Examples

### Sticky error

```clojure
(toast/show-toast! {:message "Sync failed. Retry from Settings." :variant :danger :duration 0})
```

## API reference

### `toast-flash`

Invisible marker element the runtime consumes and shows as a floating toast. Works inside hx-swap-oob fragments.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:message` | `string` | – | Toast text (required). |
| `:variant` | `:info \| :success \| :warning \| :danger` | `:info` |  |
| `:duration` | `ms` | `5000` | 0 keeps the toast until dismissed. |

### `toast`

Static toast element for previews; the runtime renders real toasts into its own container.

Children: Toast content.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:variant` | `:info \| :success \| :warning \| :danger` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `toast-classes`

Class string for {:variant}.

### `toast-class-list`

Vector form.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Click / tap | Dismisses a toast early. |

## Accessibility

- The runtime container is a polite live region, so new toasts are announced.
- Keep messages to one sentence; include the next step for errors.

## Motion

- Toasts slide in over --duration-standard with --ease-enter and fade out; reduced motion fades only.

## Responsive behavior

- Toasts stack at the bottom edge and are full width on phones.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Use toast-flash in the page or an HTMX fragment; needs ui-runtime.js.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Call show-toast!; it is a no-op when the runtime is missing.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant.

## Notes for AI

- A toast never carries the only copy of an error; errors that need action use alert.
- Success toasts are a label change in words: Export finished, not Success!

## Related

- [Alert](alert.md): A persistent inline message with a tone, icon and optional title that helps people recover or continue.
- `processing-bar`: Processing bar — compact panel showing background jobs in progress.
- [Dialog](dialog.md): A focused modal surface for decisions that need attention, as a native <dialog> or an overlay for reactive apps.

## Guidance for AI tools

Toast: A brief floating confirmation for completed background work, shown by the JS runtime on every target. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Tooltip

> Short supporting text for an unfamiliar control, shown on hover and focus with pure CSS.

- Type: Component (disclosure, Overlays)
- Namespace: `ui.tooltip`
- Source: `src/ui/tooltip.cljc`
- Public fns: `tooltip`
- Keywords: tooltip, hint, hover text, title

## When to use

- A one-line hint for an icon-only control or an abbreviation.
- Extra context that is helpful but not required to use the control.

## When not to use

- Essential information belongs in visible text; tooltips hide it from touch users.
- Use popover for rich content or anything interactive.
- Use form-field :hint for guidance under an input.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.tooltip :as tooltip])

(tooltip/tooltip {:text "Copy link"}
  (button/button {:icon :link :variant :ghost :attrs {:aria-label "Copy link"}}))
```

## API reference

### `tooltip`

Wraps children in a span that shows :text above it on hover or focus-within.

Children: The control the hint belongs to.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:text` | `string` | – | The hint. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Focusing the wrapped control shows the tooltip. |

## Accessibility

- The tooltip is a CSS pseudo-element, so it is not read by screen readers; icon-only controls still need an aria-label.
- Hover reveal is gated to hover-capable pointers so touch users do not get a double-tap.

## Motion

- Fades and lifts in over --duration-fast.

## Responsive behavior

- Hidden on touch devices; never place required information in a tooltip.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static markup, works without JS.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: :class may be a vector.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Static markup.

## Notes for AI

- Keep the text to a few words; no punctuation at the end.
- Prefer a visible label when space allows.

## Related

- [Popover](popover.md): A small anchored panel for contextual controls, built on the native Popover API so it works without app state.
- [Button](button.md): A single action with quiet secondary states, press feedback and a loading spinner.
- `icon`

## Guidance for AI tools

Tooltip: Short supporting text for an unfamiliar control, shown on hover and focus with pure CSS. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt
